name: smwpatches-overworld-layer
title: Overworld Layer 1 Events
description:
This patch allows you to make events that change layer 1 tiles on the fly: it basically works the same as the vanilla silent layer 1 events, but the changes are applied immediately instead of having to reload the map. You can change up to one layer 1 tile for each step in any event.
Make sure to check the readme for info on how to use it.
